The root cause of the earlier rejection was that the answer made a causal claim ("treatment improves") based on non-randomised, observational data. This is invalid. I must revise the answer to be purely descriptive.

I will:
- Remove any causal language.
- Report the observed difference as a descriptive statistic.
- Clearly state the limitations in the caveats.

Let’s submit with these changes.
